features.statement: Document title uses a tagline-style phrase with an em dash separator rather than a location.
Uses semantic landmark elements (header, section, footer) and a single h1 with section titles as h2, giving a clean heading hierarchy.
Link groups are marked up as ul/li lists, and footer column headings use a consistent heading level.
Images carry descriptive alt text rather than empty alt attributes.
Typography uses a single system sans-serif font (Trebuchet MS) with no custom web fonts or icon fonts.
Headlines and section titles are heavy-weight (900) bold sans-serif uppercase rather than script lettering.
Hero headline is horizontal and split into two colors, with the final phrase highlighted in yellow.
Footer column headings are small, letter-spaced white uppercase sans-serif.
Base body text is a standard 16px with compact line height and small h2 sizes.
Palette centers on navy, medium blue, bright yellow, red and purple, with pale blue as secondary text color.
Primary call-to-action buttons are fully rounded yellow pills with dark navy text.
Rounded corners and pill shapes are used widely across cards, buttons and tiles.
Secondary actions are outlined pill buttons, and paired CTAs appear as side-by-side colored pills.
Link collections are presented as rounded bordered tiles on a cream panel.
Header is a solid navy nav bar with text links between small logos.
Announcements appear as a full-width colored strip under the nav rather than a modal box.
Promo cards each have their own distinct color, left-aligned text and an arrow text link.
Footer is dark navy with text social links, a divider rule above a left-aligned copyright, and extended link columns.
Content sits in a constrained centered container with consistent left and right edges across sections.
Layout uses CSS grid alongside flexbox.
Hero is a blue gradient with rounded photo cards captioned by name.
Feature sections use full-bleed photos with dark color overlays and left-aligned white text.
Visual effects favor gradients over shadows, transitions and transforms; decorative dividers are minimal.
Dark navy bands with light panels and underlined yellow links are used for secondary content sections.
Page is lean: no scripts or external stylesheets, minimal meta tags, few classes and almost no inline styles or ARIA.
